rules.reason: Partial last-known-good state survives a failed sibling.

rules.reason: Fail-closed result when nothing qualifies.

rules.reason: No setter, no watt inference, no zero-timeout admission.

rules.reason: No cross-version result and no FC101/FC102 semantics.
